shared.simulatedCheck: Simulated permission check, not production security.
shared.financeOnlyDescription: Starting, reconciling and retrying a payout belongs to ops finance. This identity is an ops reviewer, so the engine refuses the command as well as the page hiding it.
shared.engineWouldRefuse: The engine would refuse this command with code {code}.
shared.noAuditRecorded: A refused command records nothing: no audit entry, no notification, no amount moved.
shared.probeDescription: The control is not hidden from the demo: pressing it sends the real command so the engine's own refusal is visible.
shared.auditDescription: Every recorded decision with the actor, the reason and the status before and after.
shared.notFoundDescription: No demo record matches this address. Go back to the work queue and pick an item from there.
shared.demoToolsHint: The simulated provider outcome, the clock, the qualified views and the data outage are all set in the demo tools panel at the bottom of the screen.
shared.reasonRecorded: The reason is written to the audit trail.

queue.title: Work queue
queue.subtitle: Everything waiting for operations, reviewer work and finance work in one list, ordered by how long it has waited.
queue.emptyDescription: No campaign readiness, review, appeal, re-sync or payout is waiting. Load a scenario in the demo tools to see the queue fill.

kindHint.readiness: Publishing is blocked until funding evidence and the data source are confirmed.
kindHint.metering_review: A claim is reserved and waiting for the metering decision.
kindHint.escalated: Past the 48-hour review target. Escalation only: nothing is approved automatically.
kindHint.appeal: A creator contested a rejection. The reservation is still held.
kindHint.finalize_rejection: The appeal window closed or the appeal failed, so the reservation can be released.
kindHint.data_unavailable: The source could not be read. The last trusted value is kept; unknown is not zero.
kindHint.payout: A confirmed obligation has no payout attempt yet.
kindHint.payout_unknown: An attempt came back unknown. Reconcile the original transaction; never pay again.

queue.noMatchDescription: Items are still waiting, but none of them matches the scope and kind selected above. The filters are left as they are.

readiness.listSubtitle: Funding evidence and data-source readiness per campaign. This is the operations-side control the merchant's publish preview refers to.
readiness.listEmptyDescription: There is no campaign in the demo data yet.
readiness.title: Readiness · {campaign}
readiness.subtitle: Publishing stays blocked until both rows are confirmed. Both switches are simulated evidence, not a funding or provider integration.
readiness.rowFundingDescription: Simulated proof that the reward pool is funded. No payment provider is contacted.
readiness.rowDataSourceDescription: Simulated confirmation that the selected platforms can be read for qualified views.
readiness.blockingDescription: The merchant cannot publish this campaign while anything below is unconfirmed.
readiness.blockingNone: Nothing blocks publishing. The merchant can publish this campaign.
readiness.blockedDataSource: The data source is not confirmed.
readiness.publishedNote: This campaign is already published, so readiness is a record rather than a gate.
readiness.confirmDescription: This changes whether the merchant may publish the campaign, and it is recorded in the audit trail.
readiness.changed: Readiness updated in the demo record.

submission.listSubtitle: Every submission in the demo data, with the trusted qualified views and the time the source last answered.
submission.listEmptyDescription: Nothing has been submitted to any campaign in this demo data.
submission.title: Submission
submission.subtitle: Metering evidence, deadlines and the claims filed against this post.
submission.snapshotsDescription: Every read of the source, trusted or not. A claim freezes the version it used. Scroll sideways to read the whole table.
submission.snapshotsEmpty: No read has been recorded yet.
submission.resyncDescription: A re-sync reads the source again at the current simulated time. It never back-dates a reading and never fabricates a number: a failed read is recorded as a failed read.
submission.resyncConfirmDescription: The read is attempted now and the result, successful or not, is written to the audit trail with your reason.
submission.resyncOutageNote: The demo data outage for this submission is still on, so the read will fail and the last trusted value will be kept.

retentionReason.published_retention: Set by the published retention period.
retentionReason.claim_deadline: Set by the effective claim deadline.
retentionReason.case_resolved: Set by the last claim or appeal on this post to be resolved.
retentionReason.settlement: Set by the last confirmed payment on this post to complete.
retentionReason.open_cases: An open case has no end date yet, so retention is not decided.
retentionReason.confirmed_unpaid: Confirmed money is still unpaid, so retention is not decided.

submission.extensionNote: An extension gives back the merchant's published grace from the moment the block cleared. It never extends the metering window and never re-opens an old queue position.
submission.contentReviewDescription: The merchant owns this decision. Operations can read it but cannot change it.
submission.claimsEmpty: No claim has been filed against this submission.

claim.listSubtitle: Every claim in the demo data by queue position, with its metering review and whether it passed the 48-hour target.
claim.listEmptyDescription: No creator has filed a claim in this demo data.
claim.title: Claim review
claim.subtitle: The frozen evidence behind one reserved amount, the two independent reviews and the release of the reservation.
claim.evidenceDescription: A claim keeps the snapshot version, the qualified views and the rule version it was filed under. Later reads never change a filed claim.
claim.partialDescription: The creator consented to a smaller amount. The remainder of {remainder} is neither reserved nor forfeited.
claim.reviewsDescription: Content review belongs to the merchant, metering review to operations. One approval alone never shows payment: a claim becomes confirmed unpaid only when both are approved.
claim.meteringPanelDescription: Approve when the evidence supports the amount. Hold when something must be checked first. Reject when the evidence does not support the amount; a rejection holds the reservation until it is finalised.
claim.approveConfirmDescription: If the merchant has already approved the content, this confirms the claim and creates a payout obligation.
claim.holdConfirmTitle: Put the metering review on hold?
claim.holdConfirmDescription: The claim stays pending and the creator is told why. A reason is required.
claim.rejectConfirmDescription: The reservation stays held for the whole appeal window. A reason is required and the creator can appeal against it.
claim.decidedNote: This review is already decided, so it cannot be decided again. An upheld appeal is what returns a claim to review.
claim.notPendingNote: Only a claim that is pending review can be decided. This claim is {status}.
claim.escalatedDescription: This claim passed the 48-hour review target at {at}. Escalation is a notification only: nothing is approved automatically and the amount is unchanged.
claim.reservationHeld: The reservation of {amount} is still held. Releasing it needs an explicit decision here.
claim.finalizeConfirmDescription: The reserved amount returns to available. This is recorded, the creator and the merchant are told, and it cannot be undone in the demo.
claim.finalizeDone: Rejection finalised and the reservation released.
claim.finalizeBlockedTitle: The reservation cannot be released yet

finalizeBlocked.appeal_open: An appeal is open. Resolve the appeal first; a release is never a timed job.
finalizeBlocked.appeal_window_open: The appeal window is still open until {deadline}. The reservation is held until then.
finalizeBlocked.claim_not_rejected_appealable: This claim is not in a rejected state that can be released.
finalizeBlocked.no_rejection_record: No rejection record exists for this claim.
finalizeBlocked.other: The engine refuses the release for now.

claim.confirmedDescription: Both reviews approved, so an obligation of {amount} exists. No money has moved: paying it is a finance action.

appeal.listSubtitle: Every appeal in the demo data. An open appeal holds the reservation until it is resolved.
appeal.listEmptyDescription: No creator has appealed against a rejection in this demo data.
appeal.title: Appeal
appeal.subtitle: The creator's case against a rejection, the original decision and the evidence both were read against.
appeal.evidenceDescription: The snapshots of the submission behind the claim. Resolving an appeal never rewrites them.
appeal.decideDescription: Uphold when the creator is right: the claim returns to review keeping its queue position, its valid time and its amount. Reject when the original decision stands: the reservation is still held and a separate finalise step releases it.
appeal.upholdConfirmDescription: The claim goes back to pending review with the same queue position, valid time and amount, and the review that rejected it is reset to pending.
appeal.rejectConfirmDescription: The rejection stands. The reservation stays held: it is released only when the rejection is finalised.
appeal.alreadyResolvedDescription: This appeal was resolved at {at} and cannot be decided again.
appeal.outcomeUpheldNote: Upheld: the claim is back in review with the same queue position and amount, and the reservation was never released.
appeal.outcomeRejectedNote: Rejected: the reservation is still held. Finalise the rejection on the claim page to release it.

payout.listSubtitle: Confirmed obligations and their attempts. Paid means funds are available in the simulated provider account; bank settlement is a separate fact.
payout.listEmptyDescription: No claim has been confirmed, so there is nothing to pay in this demo data.
payout.title: Payout
payout.subtitle: One obligation, every attempt against it, and the reconciliation record for an unknown result.
payout.providerAvailableAt: Funds available in the provider account
payout.bankSettlementDescription: Bank arrival is a separate fact and is never inferred from a provider success. The demo has no evidence of it.
payout.startConfirmDescription: A simulated payout request is sent with a fresh request key. The simulated provider answers from the demo tools panel.

startBlocked.processing: An attempt is still processing. Wait for the simulated provider to answer.
startBlocked.unknown: An attempt came back unknown. Reconcile the original transaction before anything else.
startBlocked.settled: This obligation is already settled. Starting again would be a second payment.
startBlocked.failed: The last attempt failed. Use the controlled retry, which records the reason.

payout.attemptsDescription: Every attempt keeps its own request key and provider reference, so an unknown result can be matched against the original transaction.
payout.reconcileDescription: An unknown result is not a failure and not a payment. The only action is to check the original transaction and record what it says. There is no pay-again control here.
payout.reconcileConfirmDescription: A confirmed success settles the obligation once. A confirmed failure opens a controlled retry. Still unknown keeps the attempt unresolved.
payout.retryDescription: A retry needs a confirmed failure first. It creates a new attempt with a new request key rather than resending the old one.
payout.retryConfirmDescription: A new attempt is started with a new request key. The reason is recorded in the audit trail.
payout.settledDescription: The simulated provider confirmed that {amount} is available in the creator's provider account at {at}.
payout.noPayAgain: There is deliberately no pay-again control for an unknown result.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.subtitle: Everything the demo is currently treating as an exception, with what it is about, since when, who last acted and the recorded reason.
exceptions.emptyDescription: No submission is unreadable, no payout is unknown or failed, no claim is escalated and no deadline was extended.

kindHint.data_unavailable: The last trusted value and its time are kept. Unknown is not zero and is not cheating.
kindHint.payout_unknown: Reconcile the original transaction. Never pay again on an unknown result.
kindHint.payout_failed: A confirmed failure allows one controlled retry with a recorded reason.
kindHint.escalated: Escalation only. Nothing is approved automatically.
kindHint.extension: The merchant's published grace was given back from the moment the block cleared.

closure.title: Campaign closure
closure.subtitle: What still has to be resolved before this campaign can be called settled. The merchant reads the same verdict.
closure.settled: Every case and payout is resolved
closure.settledNote: No open appeal, no claim awaiting review, no confirmed amount unpaid and no unresolved payout attempt.
closure.notSettledNote: This campaign may not be shown as fully settled while any of the following is open.
closure.blockerPendingClaims: {count} claim(s) awaiting a decision or holding a reservation
closure.blockerUnresolvedPayouts: {count} payout attempt(s) still processing or unknown
closure.tail: Unconfirmed tail below the minimum claim
closure.tailNote: Disclosed before closure under the published rule. It is not a payable amount and no payment is promised.
closure.refundNote: M1 has no automatic refund path. The amount and the route are decided outside the prototype.
closure.poolNote: Available in the pool right now: {currency}. The four amounts always add up to the pool.
